items.quote: the CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be somewhere between 14,000 to 15,000 crores
items.statement: Five-year capex plan of INR 14,000-15,000 crore (about 3,000 crore a year)
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: we expect almost 47,000 crores of orders to materialize in this 1-year timeframe
items.statement: Order inflow of about INR 47,000 crore within the next 1 year
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: we expect the outstanding order book position to be somewhere around 1,20,000 crores
items.statement: Order book of about INR 1,20,000 crore as on 31 March 2025
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: The aggregate value of all these orders is expected to be somewhere around 1,60,000 to 1,70,000 crores
items.statement: Aggregate value of pipeline orders of INR 1,60,000-1,70,000 crore to materialise
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: we expected to bring it down to further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year
items.statement: Manpower cost to fall to 16% of revenue in FY25
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: the manufacturing growth definitely it has to be around 15% to 18% growth has to be there every year
items.statement: Manufacturing revenue growth of 15-18% every year
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: the repair and overall growth of around 9% to 10% growth
items.statement: Repair and overhaul (ROH) revenue growth of 9-10%
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: it should be somewhere between 8% to 9% growth should be there in ROH activities
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: we will be able to show a consistent double-digit growth
items.statement: Consistent double-digit revenue growth on the current order book
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: So, this would mean that it should be somewhere around 30%-31% should be our EBITDA margin.
items.statement: EBITDA margin of about 30-31% (including interest income)
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: Yes, without interest income it should be somewhere around 26%-27%
items.statement: EBITDA margin of about 26-27% excluding interest income
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: commencing deliveries of Light Utility Helicopters as well
items.statement: Start deliveries of Light Utility Helicopters in FY25
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: we will commence delivery of our HTT-40 basic trainer and Civil ALH
items.statement: Commence HTT-40 trainer and Civil ALH deliveries in FY26
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: the third line is likely to become operational from October of the current financial year
items.statement: Nashik third production line operational from October 2024 (FY25)
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: probably in the next 6 months timeframe we should be able to have some contractual clarity on this thing
items.statement: Contractual clarity on the Sukhoi upgrade programme within 6 months
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: we are planning to get the full aircraft ready by around later part of
items.statement: Prototype aircraft full build by late 2025, ready for flight around March 2026
items.speaker: Jayadeva E.P.

items.quote: we expect that we will get at least one breakthrough order with the current financial year
items.statement: At least one breakthrough export order in FY25
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: We expect the orders to get materialized in the next 1 to 2 months timeframe
items.statement: Su-30 engine order expected to be placed within 1-2 months
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

items.quote: We are confident that in the next 2 years we will be able to convert it into a commercial contract
items.statement: Convert the UHM programme into a commercial contract within 2 years
items.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan
